attempts.summary: Set up a LUKS2-encrypted volume on node1, backed by a 2GB loop file, mounted at /srv/secure with xfs. Auto-unlock at boot uses a root-only keyfile referenced in /etc/crypttab, with the mount defined in /etc/fstab. Verified via a full node reboot that the volume unlocks and mounts automatically with no manual intervention, and that data survives.
